assumptions: Model weights and bounds are finite IEEE-754 binary32 values; NaN and infinity fail closed.
Directional f32 spacing is measured once at committed W_T_32 and widened exactly to f64.
Separate downward and upward spacings handle exponent transitions and signed zero.
Post-commit safety requires 32 actual successive legal representable moves in both directions and is stronger than the continuous distance proxy.
Boundary membership preserves lower versus upper committed membership exactly, using bitwise comparison where signed zero matters.
Permitted support and source-coordinate order are inherited unchanged from Q09 and Q10-BG.
Fixed total norm is the f64 Euclidean norm of the complete displacement.
Only endpoint feasibility is assumed relevant; interpolation-path feasibility must be explicitly frozen before execution if it is to become a gate.
Q10-SM is a local equal-energy implicit-null-sphere qualification and does not solve the global box-constrained endpoint problem.
The 32-ULP reserve is an engineering representability and future-repair choice, not a behavioral or biological threshold.
Future cosine, behavior, exchangeability, direction-effect, future-learning-state, and metaplasticity gates and claims remain unset.
claims_explicitly_forbidden: meaningful directional separation from endpoint existence alone
